exposure: gestational age at delivery (37 weeks, 38 weeks, 39 weeks, 40 weeks, 41 weeks, >42 weeks)
cohort: 44,698 women with singleton pregnancies at term
finding: Induction of labor, compared to expectant management, was associated with lower rates of spontaneous vaginal delivery and a higher risk of emergency cesarean section for intrapartum fetal compromise at term.
mod_finding: Induction of labor was associated with a lower likelihood of spontaneous vaginal delivery.
